facts.fact: Amnesty, RSF and Internet Sans Frontieres state that the HAAC suspended the newspaper Le Patriote and its website on 21 January 2025 after an editorial on the government's security strategy.

Amnesty, RSF and Internet Sans Frontieres state that the HAAC suspended the news website Benin Web TV on 12 March 2025 over articles on the HAAC's budget request and its president's car request, and withdrew its director's press card.

Le Patriote published an editorial pointing out 'the government's ineffective strategy' during an attack on a military position near the Burkina Faso-Niger border, per Amnesty, RSF and Internet Sans Frontieres.
